questions.question: Which keyword is used to define a structure in C?
How do you access a member of a structure variable s using the member name age?
How do you access a structure member through a pointer p to the structure?
Can a structure contain members of different data types?
options: A. No, all members must have the same type
B. Yes, members can have different data types
C. Only if all members are pointers

questions.question: What is an array of structures?
options: A. An array where each element is a structure object of the same structure type
B. A structure containing only arrays
C. A pointer to one structure

questions.question: Which operator accesses a member through a structure pointer?
What happens when a structure is passed to a function by value?
options: A. A copy of the structure value is passed
B. Only its first member is passed
D. The compiler converts it to a union

questions.question: What is typedef commonly used for with structures?
options: A. To create a convenient alias for a structure type
B. To allocate heap memory automatically
C. To make every member static

questions.question: Can a structure contain a pointer member?
options: C. Only if the pointer is NULL

questions.question: Which statement best describes structure memory layout?
options: A. Members are stored according to implementation-defined layout rules and may include padding
B. Every structure is always packed with no padding
C. All members always share the same address
